capabilities.text: Draw the syringe alone, or set up with a conical flask, delivery tube and stand
capabilities.note: Opening state is with flask and stand; the token switches to the syringe alone.
Ours also has a drag/scroll plunger handle for this.

capabilities.text: Pick a random volume (0 to full scale, one decimal place)
A magnifier above the syringe, or none
capabilities.note: The magnifier is on at the opening state; the token removes it.

capabilities.text: The magnifier in place of the syringe
Choose how many numbered marks (1 to 6) the magnifier spans
An answer key line with the volume under the figure
